question: What shape and uniform measurement are required for the stones used in this construction?
premises: They are prescribed as to be made in that form.
Their measure is a hand-span on all sides.
inference: The construction requires square stones uniformly measuring one hand-span on every side.
uncertainties: The exact length of kara (hand/cubit measure) can vary by convention.
plain_english: The stones should be made square, measuring one hand-span on all sides.
